row:
Bodyology Massage School offers two different services: 
We are a world-class massage school located in London, United Kingdom. We offer in-person, all-level massage courses and training that are based on solid accreditation, individual support, interactive & fun learning methods. You will get all you need to become a great massage therapist. 
Bodyology also offers great all-levels online massage courses, events and educational tips. 
We are experts in teaching massage techniques, anatomy, physiology, and pathology, ‘tailoring’ massage treatments, building a rapport & safe space with clients, marketing for therapists, risk assessment & more. 
We love sharing our massage knowledge with the world on YouTube. It’s a way to give back to the world and help people in those rural, distant locations. 
We produce one new video every week. Subscribe to our channel to receive a notification for every new video. Also, it promotes our videos to be shown to more people on YouTube. 
Bodyology team
